technical_quality: Adequate erect PA film. Good inspiration (about 9-10 posterior ribs), no significant rotation (clavicular heads symmetric about the spinous processes), adequate penetration (thoracic spine faintly visible through the cardiac silhouette). Apices and both costophrenic angles included. Scapulae partially project over the lateral upper lung fields. 'L' side marker with technologist initials in the upper right corner of the image (patient's left), confirming conventional orientation. A narrow black collimation band along the top edge.

devices.type: Implanted subcutaneous venous access port (Port-A-Cath) with catheter
devices.location: Reservoir over the patient's right anterior upper chest wall (right infraclavicular region, about the 2nd-3rd anterior rib level); catheter loops superiorly over the right clavicle (right internal jugular route) and descends along the right mediastinal border, tip projected over the SVC at about the level of the carina, distal course faintly seen; no kink or fracture
devices.zh: 右前上胸壁植入式靜脈輸液座（Port-A-Cath），導管經右頸靜脈路徑向上繞行後沿右縱膈緣下行，尖端約投影於上腔靜脈近隆突高度，未見扭結或斷裂

devices.type: Small ring-shaped radiopaque external artifact (ECG electrode snap / nipple marker)
devices.location: Patient's right lower chest, projected over the dome of the right hemidiaphragm
devices.zh: 右下胸環狀不透光小物（心電圖電極扣／乳頭標記），投影於右橫膈頂

devices.type: Small ring-shaped radiopaque external artifact (ECG electrode snap / nipple marker)
devices.location: Patient's left lower chest, projected over the left hemidiaphragm / left costophrenic region
devices.zh: 左下胸環狀不透光小物（心電圖電極扣／乳頭標記），投影於左橫膈／左肋膈角區

devices.type: Faint small round external artifact (electrode, skin marker or clothing snap)
devices.location: Inferior edge of the film, right paramedian, projected over the upper abdomen below the diaphragm
devices.zh: 片下緣右側旁正中、橫膈下上腹部小圓形淡影（電極、皮膚標記或衣物扣）

devices.type: Radiographic side marker 'L' with technologist initials
devices.location: Upper right corner of the image (patient's left side), external to the patient
devices.zh: 影像右上角 L 側標記及技師姓名縮寫

other_findings: 主動脈弓略為突出，符合年齡相關變化，無急性意義
左橫膈下可見胃泡及腸氣，屬正常表現
兩側肩胛骨部分投影於上外側肺野，為體位所致，非病變
suitability_reason: 肺野、心影、縱膈、橫膈與肋膈角均正常，無急性心肺病變，NIH「No Finding」標籤正確；亦無胸管、引流管或豬尾導管等治療證據。惟右前胸壁有植入式靜脈輸液座（Port-A-Cath），暗示病人已有惡性腫瘤化療或長期靜脈治療病史，若作為一般「初次就診、無重大病史」的正常胸片會與病例設定矛盾並誤導學生；僅適用於病史中已載明腫瘤／化療或長期靜脈輸液座的病例。
description_zh: 站立 PA 胸部正面片，吸氣度足夠（約 9–10 根後肋）、無明顯旋轉、穿透度適當，影像右上角可見 L 側標記，雙側肩胛骨部分投影於上肺野外側。雙側肺野清晰，未見實質浸潤、結節、腫塊、肋膜積液或氣胸，雙側肋膈角銳利、橫膈輪廓平滑，右橫膈略高於左側屬正常，左橫膈下可見胃泡及腸氣。心影大小正常，縱膈未增寬，氣管居中，主動脈弓略為突出，符合年齡相關變化。右前上胸壁（右鎖骨下區、約第 2–3 前肋高度）可見植入式靜脈輸液座（Port-A-Cath），導管向上繞經右鎖骨／右內頸靜脈路徑後沿右縱膈緣下行，尖端約投影於上腔靜脈近隆突高度，未見扭結或斷裂；雙側下胸部乳頭位置各見一環狀不透光小物（電極扣或乳頭標記），片下緣右側旁正中上腹部另見一小圓形淡影，皆為體外物件。骨骼未見急性病變，整體為無急性心肺病變之正常胸片。
